verdict.rationale: mise is a local CLI: you install it on your own machine with a script (curl mise.run) or a committed wrapper, and it runs there. Its source is published on GitHub (jdx/mise), and the core tool, task runner and MCP server all run on user-controlled hosts rather than a vendor service. missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement, documentation for self-hosting or mirroring the registry and tool download sources, offline or air-gapped operation guidance, and independent corroboration of self-hosted deployments.
